title: Improved Lower Bounds on the Expected Length of Longest Common Subsequences
key_contribution: Achieves best known lower bound γ₂ ≥ 0.792666 via parallelized feasible triplet method with runtime optimizations and efficient memory scheme

title: On a Speculated Relation Between Chvátal-Sankoff Constants of Several Sequences

title: Expected Length of the Longest Common Subsequence of Multiple Strings
key_contribution: Derives asymptotically tight bounds γ_{2,d} = 1/2 + Θ(1/√d) for d random binary strings
